expectations: A memory states that the Kestrel job queue is stored in SQLite, not in Redis.

items.memory: The Kestrel job queue is stored in SQLite in WAL mode, not in Redis. The team chose SQLite so that a self-hosted Kestrel install runs as a single container with no separate queue service.
Every queue worker must open the database with a busy timeout of five seconds, because WAL mode allows only one writer at a time.
